scope: Specification only. No new evaluator, geometry, orchestration, acceptance or V25-22 restart.

semantics.PASS: Conditional future criterion-level result only when every applicable necessary subcondition has fresh same-model evidence, a valid scenario/profile and no mandatory correction; this catalog grants no PASS.
semantics.FAIL: A demonstrated violation of a known necessary condition. Keep other unresolved findings; do not erase them because FAIL dominates.
semantics.UNKNOWN: No demonstrated violation, but at least one necessary condition lacks effective profile, evidence, coverage or resolved interpretation.
semantics.missing_rule: Required predicate or applicability genuinely unspecified; absence of checker is not missing rule.
semantics.missing_profile: Qualitative rule exists, but effective scenario/anthropometric/operation/quality calibration is unqualified.
semantics.missing_evidence: Predicate known but current model lacks valid measurement, route, use or counterfactual witness.
semantics.delivery: FAIL and effective UNKNOWN block design-option display/count/delivery. Diagnostic evidence is not a design option. One criterion PASS never implies whole-model acceptance.

global_constraints: No invented numeric thresholds, weights, area caps or ergonomic calibration.
Source body width .7m and source fixture bundles are bounded study profiles, not comprehensive ergonomic approval.
Do not transfer evidence across changed geometry, profiles, programmes, or report hashes.
Daylight/ventilation sufficiency and stair/lift engineering are POST_MVP/NOT_EVALUATED; conceptual core presence/access remains.
All records retain current_state=UNKNOWN; this task runs no plan assessment.

sources.label: A9 approved study capacities and complete activities

criteria.paraphrase: Choose a source-supported usable programme from net geometry while preserving n, necessary bedrooms and all services. Try genuine core/split/placement alternatives before reducing bedrooms. Approved one-bedroom/two-person and two-bedroom/four-person design scenarios are not actual population, solver feasibility, or automatic quality approval. Do not maximize bedroom count or let mean quality hide one poor unit.
required_data: Public request and exact n; per-unit net floor/wall/common/core accounting with conventions.
Programme ID/approval provenance, per-unit sleep roles and design capacity; actual fixture dimensions and distinct instances, clothes and activities.
Source-supported lower-bound/profile inventory; log absent prefilter bounds separately from impossible geometry.
AP07 attempted alternatives, unchanged programme constraints, budgets and explicit untried branches; reduction creates a new programme alternative, not fixed-programme repair.
Fresh placement/access/operation findings and calibrated room/unit quality-floor evidence; Pareto vectors with same references, no hidden weighted score.
criteria.conditional_pass: All necessary programme and bundle uses proven for each unit under qualified applicable profiles, fixed n and auditable alternative selection; quality floors and non-dominated selection supported. Not executable closure in current study.
fail_examples: Silently lower n or sleeping capacity to fit.
A required bedroom/service cannot be used under a valid known profile.
Average quality compensates for a proven failed unit.
missing_rule: Operational selection of required quality dimensions and reviewed acceptance-anchor criteria remains unresolved; the qualitative programme requirement itself exists.
missing_profile: Calibrated quality floors and reviewed scenario/equipment/activity profiles.
missing_evidence: Same-model full-bundle adequacy, AP07 comparative sequence, genuine net-capacity/prefilter and alternative-selection evidence.

existing_checker.limit: INTERNAL_INSTANCE_CAPACITY is limited source-profile evidence; CURRENT_PROGRAM_SUITABILITY remains UNKNOWN. Registry approval is independent of readiness.

known_rule_scope: No arbitrary score, weight or area cutoff may be invented.

criteria.paraphrase: Per unit verify four independent width-bearing routes: entry→living, entry→actual dining use destination, entry→WC, living↔dining. Required guest movement must avoid actual kitchen equipment, effective opening/motion and cooking/use areas in required scenarios. An enclosed kitchen or separate corridor is not mandated. Guest arrival should reach living without forced travel through dining occupation or cooking.
required_data: Unit and real entry/threshold IDs; actual living/dining/WC activity destinations bound to fixtures and source modules.
Current floor/walls/openings, cabinet bodies, effective door/drawer/fridge motions and cooking/workstation activity envelopes.
Scenario of door/chair states and simultaneous necessary uses; qualified profile and width, connected swept body routes, actual openings and bottleneck evidence.
WC private-domain exclusion; first-living ordering witness, graphical and geometric evidence from identical model hash.
criteria.conditional_pass: All four route subtests and applicable first-living/private-access requirements proven with valid same-model scenario/profile; successes are not transferable between routes or to overall programme.
fail_examples: Only usable dining connection passes through required kitchen work/use area.
Living path succeeds but dining destination is disconnected.
WC guest access necessarily cuts private sleeping domain under applicable requirement.
missing_profile: Effective route/activity width, simultaneous-operation scenario and ergonomic support may be unqualified.
missing_evidence: All four actual destination routes, bottlenecks/openings, first-living and effective-state coverage on same model.

existing_checker.limit: Attached bounded source-profile route study does not close first-living/scenario/ergonomic requirements; legacy whole-kitchen-floor exclusion is conservative, not equivalent to work-area rule.

proposed_tests.case: Entry→living clear, dining only via cooking

proposed_tests.expected: Do not reject solely because labelled kitchen; evaluate actual rule

proposed_tests.case: Missing effective profile

proposed_tests.expected: Limited existence evidence, not proof of principal/natural organisation

known_rule_scope: No requirement for a separate corridor or whole-kitchen-floor prohibition; do not invent these.

criteria.paraphrase: Living must be a genuinely continuous furnishable and usable floor, not a label, bounding box, narrow neck or leftover winding strip. Internal furniture use and width-bearing movement evidence remain necessary even when movable furniture is omitted from output. Compare long circulation with a genuinely shorter organisation under the same programme.
required_data: Exact non-overlapping actual living-floor union, excluded kitchen/dining/threshold/private circulation and accounting conventions.

Actual source-bound seating fixtures, activity targets, all required design persons, access/use and simultaneous-use scenarios. Access routes may traverse authorized circulation; circulation area does not thereby become useful living.

Separate witnesses: a claimed living-floor continuity path must remain in that explicitly defined floor scope; actual access paths use their valid floor/circulation domain. Record coherent furnishing/group use, route lengths/turns/bottlenecks and shorter alternative with rejection reasons.
Functional useful area distinguished from residual geometry, fixture footprints and released wall material; comparable denominators.
criteria.conditional_pass: Necessary furnishing, cohesive use, floor continuity and applicable quality/comparison requirements all proven for each unit under valid profiles; mere seat connectivity is insufficient.
fail_examples: A required furniture activity or access is demonstrably unusable.
A labelled living strip cannot support required programme under a valid profile.
missing_profile: Reviewed quality anchors and necessary activity/room-floor thresholds remain incomplete.
missing_evidence: Same-model coherent group use and continuous functional floor, true useful-area accounting and shorter valid organisation comparison.

existing_checker.limit: Seat-access connectivity and route metrics are partial diagnostics, not continuous useful living or quality approval; overall ID remains UNKNOWN.

proposed_tests.expected: Reject that witness only; do not reject a valid access route merely for traversing authorized circulation

proposed_tests.expected: No automatic PASS; quality/use comparison unresolved

proposed_tests.expected: Proven absence of a required seat under a valid profile: FAIL that subcondition. Missing data or unbound target: UNKNOWN/invalid evidence, never vacuous PASS.

known_rule_scope: No universal golden ratio, corridor-length cap, waste percentage or arbitrary compactness threshold is authorized.
Living-floor continuity and real access routing have distinct domains. A source-labelled entry_circulation access path is not forbidden by this rule, nor counted automatically as useful living.

criteria.paraphrase: Do not retain an added wall or L arm whose only function is hiding private views without bounding a genuinely usable space. Real bedroom/bath/closet boundaries may be functional, but names, one-ended attachment or a privacy PASS do not prove it. For each added wall record identity, geometry, function and removal/alternative effects; resolve privacy through real organisation rather than fictitious spaces.
required_data: Complete added-wall inventory and same-image IDs; exact source/placement/material aliases and geometry.
Real served space, usable fixture/activity evidence, clear widths and role beyond visibility masking.
Counterfactual removal or alternative positioning with unchanged programme and exact material-union differences (overlapping aliases preserved).
Fresh comparison of actual usable area, route length/access, furnishing and privacy; same-model provenance and dependent rechecks after changes.
Separate physical material released from proven functional useful-area gain; identify conceptual core scope and avoid blanket permission to remove structural/core walls.
criteria.conditional_pass: Every applicable added wall has genuine functional/use evidence and required same-programme comparison; no only-view screen or fictitious serving space remains, and dependent privacy/access/use requirements hold. No automatic closure from provenance alone.
fail_examples: Wall proven to serve only view masking with no real usable boundary.
Rename screen as hall/storage while keeping same nonfunctional geometry.
missing_profile: Specific use/privacy scenario may need qualification; do not generalize one body-width study.
missing_evidence: Per-wall function/use and removal/alternative records; unchanged programme and exact alias-aware geometry; current dependent checks.

existing_checker.limit: No complete per-wall alternative proof is installed; provenance, closure dependency or detached probes alone do not imply necessity/quality. ID remains UNKNOWN.
